description:
Our Company 
 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We empower people to create, collaborate, and deliver exceptional experiences—and our operations teams play a critical role in making that possible at scale.
 
 The Opportunity 
 The Creativity & Productivity (C&P) Operations team is seeking an Operations AI Developer to advance operational excellence using applied AI. This role combines operations, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. It focuses on identifying, designing, building, and deploying intelligent solutions to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making across the organization.
 
 This position is just beginning — you will help set the course, not only follow it. Your main focus will be building internal tools that simplify how the C&P Operations organization operates. You will be finding opportunities to boost efficiency in workflows and connecting with a wider executive network that is being developed. The solutions made here may grow beyond C&P and reach across Adobe, so the quality, maintainability, and care in your work matter greatly. Comfort with unclear situations and the skill to build frameworks from nothing are crucial.
 
 You will be part of the Product Operations organization that reports into the Office of the President of C&P. You will work and collaborate closely with C&P Operations Leaders, engineering, and the Adobe Technical Systems (ATS) team. Your role is to convert real business needs into practical, scalable solutions. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role where you can influence how AI is adopted and expanded not only within C&P but possibly across Adobe.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities to apply AI and other tooling across C&P Operations workflows and processes
 Design, develop, and roll out AI agents, copilots, and automation tools that boost operational efficiency — focused primarily on internal applications across C&P, with potential to extend Adobe-wide
 Collaborate across departments with operations, engineering, and the ATS team to transform business needs into scalable solutions
 Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on tools powered by artificial intelligence using modern frameworks (LLMs, agent architectures, automation platforms)
 Connect new solutions into existing tools and the emerging executive ecosystem to ensure cohesion across the broader ops organization
 Build with Adobe-wide scalability in mind — solutions should be maintainable, well-documented, and transferable beyond their initial context
 Establish and promote guidelines for responsible AI usage, governance, and operationalization
 Drive adoption by building intuitive, high-value solutions aligned to real user workflows
 Monitor performance, measure impact, and continuously improve deployed solutions in partnership with ops and analytics teams
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 5+ years of software development experience, with a strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals
 Background in AI/ML, computer science, or a related technical field
 Experience working with extensive language models and contemporary AI frameworks
 Demonstrated capability to develop AI-driven applications, agents, or automation solutions
 Skilled in Python or comparable languages, with experience handling APIs, MCPs, and integrations
 Solid software engineering practices: clean code, version control (Git), testing rigor, and maintainability
 Experience building and maintaining production systems beyond the prototype stage
 Comfort working with data — querying, transforming, and visualizing operational metrics
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deploying solutions in enterprise environments
 Understanding of security considerations when building AI-integrated tools
 Strong problem-solving skills and genuine curiosity for exploring new technologies
 Ability to move quickly from concept to prototype and iterate based on feedback
 Effective communicator who can bridge technical and business perspectives — including with senior leadership
 Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and drive outcomes with limited direction
 
 Nice to Have 
 Exposure to operations, process design, or enterprise tooling ecosystems
 Experience designing or contributing to executive-facing tools or dashboards
 Experience building solutions intended to scale across a large, matrixed organization
 Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices in an enterprise context
 Interest in shaping AI strategy within a business function
 Experience working in a cross-functional environment alongside both engineering and non-engineering collaborators
 
 Impact 
 This role is crucial for transforming C&P Operations and may influence Adobe’s large-scale approach. Within the operations group of the Office of the President of C&P, you will gain access to the priorities and strategy of one of Adobe’s key business units. You will join as a founding member in defining AI’s role in Adobe’s operations. Your work will develop new tools that link to a growing executive network and extend past a single team. The impact of your work could shape how Adobe and its wider organization operate and expand.

 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 
 
Let’s Adobe together 
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .

 AI Use Guidelines for Interviews: 
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .
  
 Expected Pay Range: 
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $159,200 - $301,600 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

In California, the pay range for this position is $208,300 - $301,600
 
 At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans.  Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).
 
 In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

 State-Specific Notices: 

 California : 
 Fair Chance Ordinances 
 Adobe will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

 Colorado: 
 Application Window Notice 
 
 If this role is open to hiring in Colorado (as listed on the job posting), the application window will remain open until at least the date and time stated above in Pacific Time, in compliance with Colorado pay transparency regulations. If this role does not have Colorado listed as a hiring location, no specific application window applies, and the posting may close at any time based on hiring needs.

 Massachusetts Legal Notice 
 It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
